cases.note: bars: the series' itemStyle shadow; item 1 its own shadowOffsetY 5 and shadowColor #ff0000 over it key by key; item 2 shadowBlur null (falls through); the second series only a blur (the colour '#000'), a blur of 0 with offsets on item 0 of a third, a negative blur on its item 1
bar-brush's emphasis.itemStyle shadow: none at rest, the highlighted bar its blur 10 in rgba(0,0,0,0.3)
a line: lineStyle shadow (the polyline), areaStyle shadow (the area), itemStyle shadow (the symbols, item 2 its own colour)
scatter symbols: the series' shadow (bubble-gradient's), item 1 its own; an effectScatter's symbol its itemStyle's, its ripples none
a pie: item 0 its own itemStyle shadow (pie-custom's 200), labelLine.lineStyle shadow on every line
pie-simple's emphasis shadow: the highlighted slice blur 10, offsetX 0, rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
funnel trapezoids: itemStyle shadow

a gauge (gauge-clock's and gauge-speed's): axisLine.lineStyle, splitLine.lineStyle (width 3), axisTick.lineStyle (width 1), anchor.itemStyle; the series' itemStyle under the progress arc and the pointer, pointer.itemStyle over it; item 1 its own pointer.itemStyle blur
a radar item's polyline (lineStyle), polygon (areaStyle) and symbols (itemStyle); item 1 its own lineStyle colour
candlesticks (itemStyle shadow) and boxplots (itemStyle shadow)
BoxplotSeries' emphasis.itemStyle default: the highlighted box a blur of 5 at (1, 1) in tokens.color.shadow
heatmap-cartesian's emphasis shadow on the highlighted cell; the series' own itemStyle shadow at rest
graph nodes (itemStyle, a category's over the series', a node's own over both) and edges (lineStyle, a link's own)
tree nodes (itemStyle) and edges (the node's lineStyle); node b its own
treemap rects: the series' itemStyle shadow (getItemStyleNormal), a level's and a node's own
sunburst pieces: itemStyle shadow, a node its own
sankey nodes (itemStyle) and links (lineStyle through getItemStyle), a link's own
themeRiver-basic's emphasis shadow (blur 20, rgba(0,0,0,0.8)) on the highlighted layer; none at rest
parallel lines and a lines series: lineStyle shadow, an item's own
a pictorial bar's glyphs (itemStyle shadow) on a grid; a polar bar's sectors

a bar label's box: backgroundColor with shadowBlur 4, shadowColor #333, offsetY 2; a rich token's own box with its own shadow (offsetX 3, #f00); the second series' box a blur with no colour: the text style's prototype '#000' (shadowColor || 'transparent' never reaches 'transparent')
bar-rich-text's rich token a: textShadowBlur 2, #000, (0, 1); token b none; a plain label's textShadowBlur 0 with an offset (no shadow)

whole.note: a bar's markPoint (itemStyle shadow), markLine (lineStyle shadow) and markArea (itemStyle shadow)
a matrix: backgroundStyle's shadow on the background (not the border), the body's cells' itemStyle, the x dimension's dividerLineStyle
a slider: handleStyle, moveHandleStyle, dataBackground's areaStyle and lineStyle shadows
line-graphic's: a graphic rect's style shadow, a circle's own
a legend box: backgroundColor with the legend's own shadow keys
radar-custom's: the radar component's splitArea.areaStyle shadow, splitLine.lineStyle and axisLine.lineStyle
a calendar: the day cells' itemStyle shadow, the split lines' lineStyle shadow
a map series' regions: itemStyle shadow, region B its own colour; then B highlighted: its emphasis shadow (blur 9)
a geo component's regions: its itemStyle shadow
a continuous visualMap's handles: handleStyle's shadow

layers.note: series 0 at zlevel 1 (z 2) over series 1 at zlevel 0 z 10 (overlapping bars), its labels with it; series 1's markPoint at its own zlevel 2
lines-ny's blendMode 'lighter' on a bar series: every bar, not its labels; the other series none
the root's zlevel 3 reaches a series that writes none (the series model's parent is the option)

anim.note: a bar's emphasis.itemStyle shadow (blur 10, offsetY 4, rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) by a highlight at 0 and a downplay at 500: stateAnimation's 300 ms cubicOut from the rest's prototype 0, 0, '#000' and back
a bar's own shadow (blur 4, #ff0000) under an emphasis shadow (blur 12): from 4 to 12 in the bar's colour, the emphasis naming none

guards.name: emphasisTween: 0 at rest, between at 150, 10 from 300, back to 0 from 800
restTween: from 4 to 12 in #ff0000
map: the regions, B its own colour, then B blur 9
markers: the three blocks
matrix: background, cells and the divider; the border none
dataZoom: four shadows
toolbox, graphic, legend, visualMap
zlevel: series 0 and its labels at 1, after series 1 (z 10); the markPoint at 2
blend: series 0's bars 'lighter', its labels not, series 1 none
rootLevel: the root zlevel 3 on the bars
bar: the series' shadow, item 1 its own oy 5 and #ff0000 over it
bar: a blur alone leaves the colour the prototype's
barEmphasis: nothing at rest, the blur once highlighted
line: the polyline its lineStyle, the area its areaStyle, a symbol its itemStyle
scatter: the effect symbol has it, its ripples not
pie: item 0 its 200, the others none; every label line its labelLine.lineStyle
pieEmphasis: the highlighted slice blur 10
gauge: every part as its block says
radar: line, area, symbols
boxEmphasis: the default emphasis shadow
heatEmphasis: rest 2, highlighted 10
graph: the category's colour, the node's own blur, the link's own offset
tree, treemap, sunburst, sankey carry theirs
river: the highlighted layer blur 20
parallel and lines
pictorial glyphs and polar bars
richText: token a's TSpan its shadow, b's none, a blur of 0 none
